about.title: From one polyclinic in Ruwi to a GCC group
body: The venture was started off in Ruwi, Oman, by a group of renowned visionaries in 2002, aiming to provide world-class multispecialty healthcare at affordable costs.

Made its humble beginning as Polyclinic in 2002 and gradually became the largest private healthcare group of Oman. The group spread its wings and became multinational, having presence in Oman, Bahrain, UAE, Kuwait and Qatar.

points.title: JCI accredited
points.text: Badr Al Samaa Hospital Ruwi and Al Khoud hold Joint Commission International accreditation, first awarded in 2016.

points.title: ACHSI accredited
points.text: Six hospitals (Ruwi, Al Khoud, Barka, Sohar, Salalah and Nizwa) are accredited by the Australian Council on Healthcare Standards International.

more: The three directors, Dr. P A Mohammed, Dr. V T Vinod and Mr. Abdul Latheef, did the humble beginning of this leading healthcare group in Oman from as a polyclinic in Ruwi in 2002.

Aggressive expansion mode with advanced facilities coming up in Oman like Al Hail, Azaibah, Al Khuwair and other GCC countries. In Oman the group is introducing advanced facilities for IVF, Ophthalmology & Cancer Care.

services.title: Centres of excellence
services.intro: Eight centres of excellence lead the group's 36 specialities, from heart care and joint replacement to IVF and oncology.

detail.intro: The Cardiology Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital provides comprehensive heart care services ranging from preventive cardiology and advanced diagnostics to interventional cardiology and cardiac critical care. Our experienced cardiologists, supported by modern technology and specialized cardiac care facilities, are dedicated to the prevention, early detection, diagnosis, and heart disease treatment for a wide range of cardiovascular diseases.
body: We offer advanced non-invasive cardiac diagnostics including Electrocardiography (ECG), Echocardiography, Stress Testing (TMT), Holter Monitoring, Transesophageal Echocardiography (TEE), and other specialized cardiac assessments to accurately evaluate heart health and detect cardiovascular conditions at an early stage.

The department is equipped with advanced interventional cardiology facilities for the diagnosis and treatment of coronary artery disease and other complex cardiac conditions. Our services include coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty with stent implantation, emergency primary angioplasty for heart attack patients, and other catheter-based cardiac interventions performed using modern cardiac catheterization technology. These minimally invasive procedures help restore blood flow to the heart and improve patient outcomes while reducing recovery time.

Our dedicated Cardiac Critical Care Unit (CCU) provides round-the-clock monitoring and specialized care for patients with acute cardiac emergencies, including heart attacks, acute coronary syndrome (ACS), STEMI, NSTEMI, severe arrhythmias, heart failure, hypertensive emergencies, and other life-threatening cardiovascular conditions. Supported by advanced monitoring systems and highly trained critical care teams, we ensure rapid intervention and continuous cardiac care when every second matters.

With a strong focus on preventive cardiology, lifestyle modification, risk factor management, and advanced cardiac treatment, the Cardiology Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital is committed to helping patients achieve better heart health and improved quality of life through compassionate, evidence-based care, making us a trusted choice for those seeking the best cardiology hospital.
points: In-patient management for Cardiac emergencies (MI, ACS, STEMI, NSTEMI)

detail.intro: Our Orthopaedics, Joint Replacement & Spine Surgery Department provides comprehensive care for bone, joint, muscle, ligament, and spine conditions, helping patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and return to their daily activities with confidence.
body: Supported by experienced orthopaedic consultants & specialists, advanced surgical technology, and modern operating theatres, we offer a wide range of treatments for simple to complex musculoskeletal conditions. Our expertise includes knee, hip, and shoulder joint replacements, arthroscopic (keyhole) surgeries, sports injury management, fracture and trauma care, deformity correction, and minimally invasive spine procedures.

The department is highly advanced for performing advanced joint replacement surgeries using precision-driven techniques that promote faster recovery, improved function, and long-term mobility. We also provide specialized sports medicine services for ligament injuries, meniscus tears, tendon disorders, and sports-related trauma, helping athletes and active individuals return safely to their activities.

Our deformity correction services address conditions such as bow legs, knock knees, limb length discrepancies, post-traumatic deformities, congenital deformities, and complex bone reconstruction cases using advanced corrective and limb-lengthening techniques.

With dedicated 24/7 trauma services, comprehensive rehabilitation support, and personalized treatment plans, we deliver holistic orthopaedic care for conditions including arthritis, osteoporosis, scoliosis, back and neck disorders, fractures, and spinal deformities—ensuring the best possible outcomes for every patient.

detail.intro: The department offers antenatal and postnatal care, painless childbirth and management of high-risk pregnancies as well as family planning services. Open and laparoscopic surgical procedures for cysts, hysterectomies and C/S deliveries are routinely done too.
body: The department has been seeing an increasing number of births year-on-year and has some of the best specialists involved in infertility treatments, medical/surgical care, pregnancy care, childbirth, the time just after childbirth and any other conditions affecting the reproductive organs. Facilities include delivery suites, and prenatal and postnatal programs.
points: LSCS and other Gynec / Obstetric procedures

detail.intro: The Urology & Andrology Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital provides comprehensive diagnosis and treatment for disorders affecting the urinary tract and male reproductive system. Supported by experienced urologists, advanced technology, and modern diagnostic facilities, we deliver personalized care for a wide range of urological and andrological conditions.
body: Our specialists are experienced in the management of kidney stones, ureteric stones, prostate disorders, urinary tract infections, urinary incontinence, uro-genital cancers, and other complex urological conditions. We also offer specialized andrology services for male infertility, male fertility evaluation, erectile dysfunction, sexual health concerns, and other reproductive disorders, helping patients achieve improved reproductive health and overall well-being.

The department offers a full spectrum of treatments, including open, endoscopic, microscopic, laser, and laparoscopic urological procedures. Our advanced stone management services include lithotripsy, laser stone removal, and minimally invasive endourological procedures for the effective treatment of kidney and urinary tract stones.

We are proud to provide advanced lithotripsy services, which use shock wave technology to break kidney stones into smaller fragments that can be passed naturally, reducing the need for surgery and enabling faster recovery. Combined with modern diagnostic techniques and expert clinical care, our comprehensive stone treatment program ensures effective management of both simple and complex stone diseases.

With a patient-centred approach and access to advanced treatment options, we are committed to delivering the highest standards of urological, fertility, and andrological care, helping patients achieve better health, comfort, and quality of life.

detail.intro: The specialists are expert in disorders like dysphagia, gastrointestinal bleeding, gastrointestinal cancers, liver cirrhosis,, liver failure, infectious hepatitis, portal hypertension, acute pancreatitis, jaundice, IBS, and chronic abdominal pain and diarrhoeas, etc. Patients are provided comprehensive services for the management of gastrointestinal, hepatobiliary and pancreatic diseases involving the gastrointestinal tract.
body: Endoscopy and colonoscopy are regularly performed here along with care for hernias, ulcers, Crohn’s disease, etc. Amply supported by state-of-the-art latest technologies, the department prides itself on its innovative approaches to disease diagnosis and management.

detail.intro: The Radiology Department at Badr Al Samaa provides comprehensive diagnostic and advanced imaging services to support accurate diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing patient care. As a premier hospital for CT scan and other diagnostic services, we are equipped with modern imaging technology and supported by experienced radiologists and technologists to deliver high-quality imaging solutions across a wide range of medical specialties.
body: Our advanced imaging facilities include MRI, CT Scan, Digital X-Ray, Mammography, Bone Densitometry (DEXA), OPG, and high-resolution Ultrasound systems with Colour Doppler, 3D, and 4D imaging capabilities. Operating as a state-of-the-art private MRI centre, these services are designed to assist in the early detection, diagnosis, and monitoring of various medical conditions with precision and efficiency.

The department offers specialized imaging services, including Cardiac MRI and CT Coronary Angiography (CT Angio) for the detailed evaluation of heart structure, function, coronary artery disease, and other cardiovascular conditions. These advanced non-invasive imaging techniques provide valuable insights for the diagnosis and management of complex cardiac disorders.

We also provide advanced oncology imaging and cancer screening services, including Whole Body Cancer Screening and MRI-based cancer imaging studies, helping clinicians detect abnormalities at an early stage and monitor treatment response more effectively.

Our specialized Paediatric MRI services are designed to deliver safe, detailed, and accurate imaging for infants, children, and adolescents, supporting the diagnosis of neurological, musculoskeletal, abdominal, and congenital conditions while ensuring patient comfort throughout the examination.
points: CT Guided Procedures : Drainage of Collection

detail.intro: The ENT (Ear, Nose & Throat) Department at Badr Al Samaa provides comprehensive diagnostic, medical, and surgical care for disorders affecting the ear, nose, throat, head, and neck. Supported by experienced ENT specialists and advanced diagnostic technology, the department delivers personalized treatment for patients of all age groups, from children to adults.
body: Our specialists are experienced in managing a wide range of ENT conditions, including sinusitis, allergic rhinitis, nasal obstruction, hearing loss, ear infections, vertigo, tinnitus, tonsillitis, adenoid disorders, voice and swallowing problems, snoring, sleep-related breathing disorders, and head and neck conditions. We also provide specialized care for paediatric ENT disorders and hearing-related concerns in children.

The department offers advanced surgical services including endoscopic sinus surgery, microscopic ear surgery, tonsillectomy, adenoidectomy, septoplasty, nasal and airway procedures, and other minimally invasive ENT surgeries. Using modern endoscopic and microscopic techniques, our specialists focus on achieving effective treatment outcomes with enhanced patient comfort and faster recovery.

We also provide hearing assessment and screening services, including neonatal hearing screening, audiological evaluations, and support for patients with hearing impairment. Speech and voice-related disorders are managed through comprehensive assessment and treatment plans aimed at improving communication and quality of life.

Equipped with state-of-the-art diagnostic and surgical facilities, the ENT Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital is committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centred care for both routine and complex ear, nose, throat, and head & neck conditions.

detail.intro: Services include dental implants, dentures, sensitive teeth care, crowns & bridges, extraction/fillings, teeth whitening, RCT, gum treatment (pyorrhoea), dental jewellery, dental cleaning and bad breath elimination. Other services include surgical extraction of impacted teeth, periapical surgery, cyst enucleation, facial trauma management and jaw correction surgery.
body: Effective dental care is possible here as the dentistry department is fully-equipped with ultra modern equipments and facilities for orthodontic procedures, cosmetic modifications and oral surgical procedures. Wherever possible, there is emphasis on conservative treatment.

specialities.title: All specialities
specialities.intro: Thirty-six specialities across the network, each with its own doctors, procedures and branches.

detail.intro: The ENT (Ear, Nose & Throat) Department at Badr Al Samaa provides comprehensive diagnostic, medical, and surgical care for disorders affecting the ear, nose, throat, head, and neck. Supported by experienced ENT specialists and advanced diagnostic technology, the department delivers personalized treatment for patients of all age groups, from children to adults.
body: Our specialists are experienced in managing a wide range of ENT conditions, including sinusitis, allergic rhinitis, nasal obstruction, hearing loss, ear infections, vertigo, tinnitus, tonsillitis, adenoid disorders, voice and swallowing problems, snoring, sleep-related breathing disorders, and head and neck conditions. We also provide specialized care for paediatric ENT disorders and hearing-related concerns in children.

The department offers advanced surgical services including endoscopic sinus surgery, microscopic ear surgery, tonsillectomy, adenoidectomy, septoplasty, nasal and airway procedures, and other minimally invasive ENT surgeries. Using modern endoscopic and microscopic techniques, our specialists focus on achieving effective treatment outcomes with enhanced patient comfort and faster recovery.

We also provide hearing assessment and screening services, including neonatal hearing screening, audiological evaluations, and support for patients with hearing impairment. Speech and voice-related disorders are managed through comprehensive assessment and treatment plans aimed at improving communication and quality of life.

Equipped with state-of-the-art diagnostic and surgical facilities, the ENT Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital is committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centred care for both routine and complex ear, nose, throat, and head & neck conditions.

detail.intro: Services include dental implants, dentures, sensitive teeth care, crowns & bridges, extraction/fillings, teeth whitening, RCT, gum treatment (pyorrhoea), dental jewellery, dental cleaning and bad breath elimination. Other services include surgical extraction of impacted teeth, periapical surgery, cyst enucleation, facial trauma management and jaw correction surgery.
body: Effective dental care is possible here as the dentistry department is fully-equipped with ultra modern equipments and facilities for orthodontic procedures, cosmetic modifications and oral surgical procedures. Wherever possible, there is emphasis on conservative treatment.

detail.intro: The Dermatology Department at Badr Al Samaa provides comprehensive medical, surgical and cosmetic dermatology services for patients of all ages. Our experienced dermatologists diagnose and treat a wide range of skin, hair, and nail disorders using advanced diagnostic techniques and evidence-based treatment approaches.
body: We offer specialized care for common and complex dermatological conditions including acne, eczema, psoriasis, fungal and bacterial skin infections, pigmentation disorders, allergic skin conditions, keloids, vitiligo, nail diseases, and chronic skin disorders. Our dermatologists develop personalized treatment plans focused on improving skin health and enhancing quality of life.

The department also provides advanced hair restoration and hair loss treatments for conditions such as androgenetic alopecia, hair thinning, patchy hair loss, and scalp disorders. Treatment options include Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) therapy, mesotherapy, medical management, and customized hair rejuvenation programs designed to stimulate hair growth, strengthen hair follicles, and improve scalp health.

In addition to medical dermatology, we offer a comprehensive range of aesthetic and cosmetic procedures including skin rejuvenation, microdermabrasion, chemical peels, Botox therapy, dermal fillers, cryotherapy, laser treatments, scar revision, wart and mole removal, cyst and milia excision, and anti-ageing treatments. Our goal is to help patients achieve healthier, clearer, and more youthful-looking skin through safe and effective procedures.

The department is equipped with advanced dermatology technologies including CO2 Laser systems, radiofrequency devices, electrocautery equipment, PRP systems, dermarollers, and other modern treatment platforms, enabling us to provide precise, minimally invasive, and effective dermatological care.
points: Laser treatment of Moles & Scars and Wart Removal
Skin rejuvenation & Scars and Wart Removal
Botox Therapy for Wrinkling and Hyperhidrosis.

detail.intro: Diagnosis and management of hormone-related disease conditions including diabetes, obesity, osteoporosis, hypo/hyper thyroidism, irregular menstruation, infertility, growth and puberty, hirsutism in females, pituitary and adrenal disorders, all come under the umbrella of Endocrine disease conditions.
body: Badr Al Samaa Hospital is a leader when it comes to providing comprehensive healthcare in Oman. Our specialists here are on a mission to control the menace of these hormone-related disorders in an effective and efficient manner. The doctors are supported by state-of-the-art diagnostic tools.

detail.intro: The specialists are expert in disorders like dysphagia, gastrointestinal bleeding, gastrointestinal cancers, liver cirrhosis,, liver failure, infectious hepatitis, portal hypertension, acute pancreatitis, jaundice, IBS, and chronic abdominal pain and diarrhoeas, etc. Patients are provided comprehensive services for the management of gastrointestinal, hepatobiliary and pancreatic diseases involving the gastrointestinal tract.
body: Endoscopy and colonoscopy are regularly performed here along with care for hernias, ulcers, Crohn’s disease, etc. Amply supported by state-of-the-art latest technologies, the department prides itself on its innovative approaches to disease diagnosis and management.

detail.intro: The department offers round-the-clock emergency care and is equipped with critical care technology including ventilators and defibrillator. Aside from outpatient and inpatient facilities for adults, the department also offers comprehensive health check-up packages specifically tailored towards various health conditions, professions, gender and age groups.
body: Aside from other facilities that include a Medical ICU and an Isolation room, the patient can also get access to OP clinics for seasonal illnesses including asthma and allergies, chronic illnesses and general medical care.

detail.intro: These expert physicians are involved in family medicine care, immunizations and handling of trauma cases. They are the first port of call for patients, and where required, they are referred to other specialists for in-depth care. General Practitioners are excellent at long-term medical care of patients, and include both children and adults.
body: The Badr Al Samaa Hospital is a leader in cost-effective healthcare in the private sector in Oman. The General Practice Department here has some of our best doctors for primary healthcare.

detail.intro: The Internal Medicine Department at Badr Al Samaa provides comprehensive medical care for adults, focusing on the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and long-term management of a wide range of acute and chronic medical conditions. Our experienced physicians are dedicated to delivering evidence-based, patient-centred care tailored to each individual's health needs.
body: The department specializes in the management of common and complex medical disorders including diabetes, hypertension, thyroid diseases, respiratory illnesses, gastrointestinal disorders, infectious diseases, kidney-related conditions, metabolic disorders, and cardiovascular risk factors. As a trusted hospital for asthma treatment, we also provide expert care for patients with multiple medical conditions requiring coordinated and comprehensive treatment.

Our physicians emphasize preventive healthcare and early disease detection through regular health assessments, lifestyle counselling, risk factor management, and personalized treatment plans. By focusing on prevention and long-term disease control, we help patients maintain better health and improve their overall quality of life.

The department works closely with other specialties to provide integrated care for patients with complex medical conditions. Supported by advanced diagnostic facilities and modern laboratory services, we ensure accurate diagnosis, timely intervention, and continuous monitoring for optimal health outcomes.

The department specializes in the management of Type 1 Diabetes, Type 2 Diabetes, gestational diabetes, prediabetes, obesity, metabolic syndrome, hypertension, dyslipidaemia, thyroid disorders, and other lifestyle-related medical conditions. Through regular monitoring, medication management, patient education, and lifestyle counselling, we help patients achieve better disease control and reduce the risk of complications.
points: Treatment for Chronic Respiratory Diseases (Asthma & COPD)

detail.intro: The Nephrology Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital provides comprehensive care for patients with kidney-related diseases, hypertension, and disorders affecting kidney function. Our experienced nephrology specialists are dedicated to the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and long-term management of both acute and chronic kidney conditions, helping patients maintain better kidney health and overall well-being.
body: The department specializes in the management of chronic kidney disease (CKD), kidney failure treatment, diabetic nephropathy, hypertension-related kidney disorders, glomerular diseases, kidney stones, electrolyte imbalances, acute kidney injury, and other complex renal conditions. We also provide kidney health screening, preventive care, and early intervention programs to help reduce the risk of progressive kidney disease.

Badr Al Samaa Hospital is proud to be among the pioneers in providing advanced dialysis services in the private healthcare sector in Oman. Our dedicated dialysis centre offers high-quality haemodialysis care in a safe, comfortable, and patient-focused environment. Supported by experienced nephrologists, specially trained dialysis nurses, and modern dialysis technology, we ensure personalized treatment and continuous monitoring for patients requiring long-term renal replacement therapy.

The department also performs specialized nephrology procedures, including ultrasound-guided renal biopsies, which assist in the accurate diagnosis and management of complex kidney diseases. Advanced laboratory investigations and diagnostic facilities further support comprehensive kidney care and treatment planning.

With a multidisciplinary approach and a strong focus on patient education, preventive care, and long-term disease management, our Nephrology team is committed to delivering exceptional kidney care while helping patients achieve the best possible quality of life.

detail.intro: The highly specialised services include management of stroke, epileptic fits, neuromuscular disorders, paralysis, chronic headaches and complicated migraines, vertigo, movement disorders and back pain. The department has a specialised stroke unit, a headache clinic as well as a Neuro ICU. With timely and expert treatment, most of our stroke patients have recovered and gone back to their professions.
body: Some of the latest investigative facilities available here include Nerve Conduction Studies, EEG, EMG, VEP, BAEP and CT and MRI scan.

detail.intro: The department offers antenatal and postnatal care, painless childbirth and management of high-risk pregnancies as well as family planning services. Open and laparoscopic surgical procedures for cysts, hysterectomies and C/S deliveries are routinely done too.
body: The department has been seeing an increasing number of births year-on-year and has some of the best specialists involved in infertility treatments, medical/surgical care, pregnancy care, childbirth, the time just after childbirth and any other conditions affecting the reproductive organs. Facilities include delivery suites, and prenatal and postnatal programs.
points: LSCS and other Gynec / Obstetric procedures

detail.intro: The Ophthalmology Department at Badr Al Samaa provides comprehensive eye care services for patients of all ages, offering advanced diagnostic, medical, and surgical treatments for a wide range of eye conditions. Our experienced ophthalmologists are committed to preserving and improving vision through personalized care, modern technology, and evidence-based treatment approaches.
body: The department specializes in the diagnosis and management of glaucoma, cataracts, diabetic retinopathy, hypertensive retinopathy, refractive errors, dry eye disease, corneal disorders, retinal conditions, anterior segment diseases, and other vision-related problems. We also provide comprehensive diabetic eye screening, vision assessment, spectacle prescription services, and preventive eye care to support long-term ocular health.

In addition to routine ophthalmic care, we offer a range of advanced eye surgeries and specialized procedures through our collaboration with Apex Eye Centre, a dedicated centre for advanced ophthalmic care. Patients benefit from access to modern surgical techniques and specialized expertise for cataract surgery, refractive procedures, retinal treatments, glaucoma management & glaucoma treatment, corneal care, and other complex eye conditions.

Our services also include minor ophthalmic procedures such as chalazion excision, corneal foreign body removal, post-LASIK care, and the management of various eyelid and ocular surface disorders. Supported by advanced diagnostic and vision testing technology, our team ensures accurate diagnosis and effective treatment for both common and complex eye diseases.

With a strong focus on early detection, vision preservation, and surgical excellence, the Ophthalmology Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital is dedicated to helping patients achieve and maintain optimal eye health and quality of vision.
points: Management of Refractive errors of anterior Segment disorders

detail.intro: The department is fully-equipped with anaesthesia machines, monitors, ventilators, safety gadgets and Continuous drug delivery systems. These machines are operated expertly by highly-skilled and experienced anaesthesiologists.
body: The types of anaesthesia provided here include general anaesthesia, spinal anaesthesia, caudal anaesthesia, nerve block, deep/moderate sedation, epidural analgesia/anaesthesia, MAC, etc. The Anaesthesiology Department here has some of the best anaesthesiologists experienced in a wide range of anaesthesia services including pre-operative and post-operative pain management, ICU care, emergency situations and during labour.
points: ANAESTHSIA (GENERAL AND REGIONAL ) FOR GENERAL SURGERIES

detail.intro: The Cardiology Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital provides comprehensive heart care services ranging from preventive cardiology and advanced diagnostics to interventional cardiology and cardiac critical care. Our experienced cardiologists, supported by modern technology and specialized cardiac care facilities, are dedicated to the prevention, early detection, diagnosis, and heart disease treatment for a wide range of cardiovascular diseases.
body: We offer advanced non-invasive cardiac diagnostics including Electrocardiography (ECG), Echocardiography, Stress Testing (TMT), Holter Monitoring, Transesophageal Echocardiography (TEE), and other specialized cardiac assessments to accurately evaluate heart health and detect cardiovascular conditions at an early stage.

The department is equipped with advanced interventional cardiology facilities for the diagnosis and treatment of coronary artery disease and other complex cardiac conditions. Our services include coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty with stent implantation, emergency primary angioplasty for heart attack patients, and other catheter-based cardiac interventions performed using modern cardiac catheterization technology. These minimally invasive procedures help restore blood flow to the heart and improve patient outcomes while reducing recovery time.

Our dedicated Cardiac Critical Care Unit (CCU) provides round-the-clock monitoring and specialized care for patients with acute cardiac emergencies, including heart attacks, acute coronary syndrome (ACS), STEMI, NSTEMI, severe arrhythmias, heart failure, hypertensive emergencies, and other life-threatening cardiovascular conditions. Supported by advanced monitoring systems and highly trained critical care teams, we ensure rapid intervention and continuous cardiac care when every second matters.

With a strong focus on preventive cardiology, lifestyle modification, risk factor management, and advanced cardiac treatment, the Cardiology Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital is committed to helping patients achieve better heart health and improved quality of life through compassionate, evidence-based care, making us a trusted choice for those seeking the best cardiology hospital.
points: In-patient management for Cardiac emergencies (MI, ACS, STEMI, NSTEMI)

detail.intro: Misalignment of teeth and jaw, overbites, underbites, crossbites, occlusions and overcrowded mouths are some of the conditions that a super specialised orthodontist treats. With people becoming more conscious of dental aesthetics and smile designing, our brilliant orthodontists are the experts to go to. They are experienced in creating fixed and removable braces as well as invisible braces to straighten and align your teeth and correct how they work.
body: The department also offers facilities like digital x-rays, OPG and fully-equipped dental chairs.

detail.intro: Our Orthopaedics, Joint Replacement & Spine Surgery Department provides comprehensive care for bone, joint, muscle, ligament, and spine conditions, helping patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and return to their daily activities with confidence.
body: Supported by experienced orthopaedic consultants & specialists, advanced surgical technology, and modern operating theatres, we offer a wide range of treatments for simple to complex musculoskeletal conditions. Our expertise includes knee, hip, and shoulder joint replacements, arthroscopic (keyhole) surgeries, sports injury management, fracture and trauma care, deformity correction, and minimally invasive spine procedures.

The department is highly advanced for performing advanced joint replacement surgeries using precision-driven techniques that promote faster recovery, improved function, and long-term mobility. We also provide specialized sports medicine services for ligament injuries, meniscus tears, tendon disorders, and sports-related trauma, helping athletes and active individuals return safely to their activities.

Our deformity correction services address conditions such as bow legs, knock knees, limb length discrepancies, post-traumatic deformities, congenital deformities, and complex bone reconstruction cases using advanced corrective and limb-lengthening techniques.

With dedicated 24/7 trauma services, comprehensive rehabilitation support, and personalized treatment plans, we deliver holistic orthopaedic care for conditions including arthritis, osteoporosis, scoliosis, back and neck disorders, fractures, and spinal deformities—ensuring the best possible outcomes for every patient.

detail.intro: Super specialised neonatal care is offered to preterm and sick newborns in the Neonatal ICU. Aside from having incubators that maintain complete sterility, resuscitation equipment, phototherapy facility and a vaccination centre, these special care baby units are taken care of by expert neonatologists.
body: Along with these super specialised paediatricians, comprehensive care is also provided to the neonates in the NICU and the Neonatology clinics by specially trained nurses. Owing to the unique needs of newborn babies, parents are also trained on their care.
points: Visible light is used to treat jaundiced neon...

detail.intro: Our full-fledged department boasts of labs for haematology, clinical pathology, cytopathology, serology, microbiology, histopathology, clinical pathology and immunology. The fully automated Auto-Analyser here gives accurate results for blood sugar, lipid profile, liver function test, kidney function test, etc. Other automated machines support haematology investigations, HbA1c, cardiac troponin proteins and immunological and hormonal tests.
body: Badr Al Samaa offers one of the best laboratory set-ups in the private health sector in Oman. Having the latest automated investigative equipments here assists in accurate diagnosis of diseases.

detail.intro: Conditions treated here by our renowned specialists include depression, anxiety, various types of phobias, psychosis and sleep disturbances. The specialist doctors here offer psychotherapy to children, adolescents as well as adults on the diagnosis and treatment of addictions, mental, behavioural and emotional disorders.
body: The Department of Psychiatry in Badr Al Samaa Hospital is a first of its kind in the private health sector. We promote ‘positive mental health’ in children and adolescents aside from drug de-addiction services and prevention of substance abuse.

detail.intro: Some of the important conditions treated here include allergy and asthma, COPD, occupational lung diseases and TB. Facilities and services provided here include bronchoscopy, lung function tests (PFT) and a Smoking Cessation Clinic.
body: The Pulmonology Department of Badr Al Samaa hospital is a leader in dealing with diseases of the lungs and bronchial tubes. Our highly-experienced Pulmonologists are experts at effectively managing the care of upper and lower respiratory infections including community based pneumonia.

detail.intro: The Radiology Department at Badr Al Samaa provides comprehensive diagnostic and advanced imaging services to support accurate diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing patient care. As a premier hospital for CT scan and other diagnostic services, we are equipped with modern imaging technology and supported by experienced radiologists and technologists to deliver high-quality imaging solutions across a wide range of medical specialties.
body: Our advanced imaging facilities include MRI, CT Scan, Digital X-Ray, Mammography, Bone Densitometry (DEXA), OPG, and high-resolution Ultrasound systems with Colour Doppler, 3D, and 4D imaging capabilities. Operating as a state-of-the-art private MRI centre, these services are designed to assist in the early detection, diagnosis, and monitoring of various medical conditions with precision and efficiency.

The department offers specialized imaging services, including Cardiac MRI and CT Coronary Angiography (CT Angio) for the detailed evaluation of heart structure, function, coronary artery disease, and other cardiovascular conditions. These advanced non-invasive imaging techniques provide valuable insights for the diagnosis and management of complex cardiac disorders.

We also provide advanced oncology imaging and cancer screening services, including Whole Body Cancer Screening and MRI-based cancer imaging studies, helping clinicians detect abnormalities at an early stage and monitor treatment response more effectively.

Our specialized Paediatric MRI services are designed to deliver safe, detailed, and accurate imaging for infants, children, and adolescents, supporting the diagnosis of neurological, musculoskeletal, abdominal, and congenital conditions while ensuring patient comfort throughout the examination.
points: CT Guided Procedures : Drainage of Collection

detail.intro: The Urology & Andrology Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital provides comprehensive diagnosis and treatment for disorders affecting the urinary tract and male reproductive system. Supported by experienced urologists, advanced technology, and modern diagnostic facilities, we deliver personalized care for a wide range of urological and andrological conditions.
body: Our specialists are experienced in the management of kidney stones, ureteric stones, prostate disorders, urinary tract infections, urinary incontinence, uro-genital cancers, and other complex urological conditions. We also offer specialized andrology services for male infertility, male fertility evaluation, erectile dysfunction, sexual health concerns, and other reproductive disorders, helping patients achieve improved reproductive health and overall well-being.

The department offers a full spectrum of treatments, including open, endoscopic, microscopic, laser, and laparoscopic urological procedures. Our advanced stone management services include lithotripsy, laser stone removal, and minimally invasive endourological procedures for the effective treatment of kidney and urinary tract stones.

We are proud to provide advanced lithotripsy services, which use shock wave technology to break kidney stones into smaller fragments that can be passed naturally, reducing the need for surgery and enabling faster recovery. Combined with modern diagnostic techniques and expert clinical care, our comprehensive stone treatment program ensures effective management of both simple and complex stone diseases.

With a patient-centred approach and access to advanced treatment options, we are committed to delivering the highest standards of urological, fertility, and andrological care, helping patients achieve better health, comfort, and quality of life.

detail.intro: High efficiency, modular operating theatres with HEPA filtration system offer excellent and hassle-free usage for the latest surgical procedures being practiced in the world today. There are separate theatres available for minor procedures as well as for complex, high-risk major surgeries.
body: When the highly-experienced and renowned surgeons of Badr Al Samaa hospital are supported by such great infrastructure, the outcomes of surgeries become all the more enhanced. The various fields treated include gastroenterology, trauma, oncology, endocrinology and bariatric, cosmetology, etc.

detail.intro: The Emergency & Critical Care Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital provides round-the-clock emergency medical services and advanced critical care support for patients with life-threatening illnesses, severe injuries, and complex medical conditions. Our highly trained emergency physicians, critical care specialists, nurses, and support teams at ICU Services work together to deliver rapid assessment, timely intervention, and continuous monitoring for both adult and paediatric patients.
body: The department is equipped to manage a wide range of medical, surgical, trauma, cardiac, neurological, respiratory, and paediatric emergencies. From accident and trauma cases to acute illnesses such as heart attacks, strokes, severe infections, respiratory distress, and shock, our team is trained to provide immediate stabilisation, advanced life support, and emergency treatment when every second counts.

Our Critical Care services provide specialised management for critically ill patients requiring intensive monitoring and organ support. We offer comprehensive care for patients with severe infections, sepsis, respiratory failure, multi-organ dysfunction, post-operative complications, poisoning, and other complex medical emergencies. The department works closely with various specialties to ensure coordinated and evidence-based patient care.

The Emergency & Critical Care Department is supported by advanced medical technology and modern emergency infrastructure, including fully equipped resuscitation bays, advanced life support ambulance services, portable ventilators, cardiac monitors, portable imaging facilities, triage areas, and dedicated procedure and resuscitation rooms. Our commitment is to deliver rapid, safe, and high-quality emergency and critical care services that improve patient outcomes and save lives.

detail.intro: The physiotherapy department at Badr Al Samaa Group of Hospitals deals with the care and physical rehabilitation of patients who develops disability, pain or ailment due to various medical reasons. Physiotherapy deals with patients of various specialities like orthopaedics, cardiology, rheumatology, obstetrics & gynaecology, paediatric & neonatology, neurology, and gastroenterology among others.
body: The centre is equipped with modern physiotherapy modalities and specialized and well experienced physiotherapists.

detail.intro: Dieticians are specialised healthcare professionals licensed to assess, diagnose and treat patients on their nutritional problems in accordance with their underlying medical conditions and individual needs. They provide nutritional screening and consultation for out-patients as per request of treating physicians. They also screen all in-patients and arrange special diets according to their medical needs.
body: Badr Al Samaa Group of Hospitals and Medical Centres is a leading healthcare provider where all medical disciplines come together under one roof. The Department of Dietetics is one such specialty.

detail.intro: High efficiency, modular operating theatres with HEPA filtration system offer excellent and hassle-free usage for the latest surgical procedures being practiced in the world today. There are separate theatres available for minor procedures as well as for complex, high-risk major surgeries.
body: When the highly-experienced and renowned surgeons of Badr Al Samaa hospital are supported by such great infrastructure, the outcomes of surgeries become all the more enhanced. The various fields treated include gastroenterology, trauma, oncology, endocrinology and bariatric, cosmetology, etc.

Basic laparoscopic surgeries carried out here include cholecystectomy, appendectomy, hernioplasty, staple hemorrhoidectomy, laser hemorrhoidectomy, therapeutic endoscopic procedures, oesophageal stenting, variceal band ligation, FB ligation, etc. The department is equipped with state-of-the-art Carl Stroz Laparoscopy equipment for minimally invasive keyhole surgeries of the abdomen, spine and pelvis, making only 0.5 to 1cm sized incisions. This ensures smaller scars, faster healing time and shorter hospital stays.
The success of this department is dependent on its super specialised surgeons and availability of the latest technologies.

detail.intro: The Plastic, Reconstructive & Cosmetic Surgery Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital provides advanced surgical and non-surgical treatments designed to restore function, correct deformities, enhance appearance, and improve overall quality of life. Our department is led by highly experienced specialists with extensive expertise in reconstructive, aesthetic, craniofacial, hand, burn, and cosmetic surgery, offering comprehensive care for both adults and children.
body: Our team specializes in the management of complex reconstructive conditions resulting from trauma, burns, congenital anomalies, cancer-related defects, and soft tissue injuries. We provide personalized treatment plans aimed at restoring form and function while supporting long-term recovery and rehabilitation. Advanced reconstructive procedures are performed for facial and body defects, post-traumatic deformities, and complex wound reconstruction.

The department offers specialized expertise in craniofacial and cleft surgery, including the treatment of cleft lip and palate, craniofacial abnormalities, facial trauma, and congenital deformities. Our surgeons are experienced in managing both routine and highly complex craniofacial conditions using modern surgical techniques to achieve optimal functional and aesthetic outcomes.

Our cosmetic and aesthetic surgery services are designed to enhance natural appearance while maintaining patient safety and realistic expectations. Treatments include facial rejuvenation procedures, eyelid surgery (blepharoplasty), rhinoplasty (nose reshaping), dimple creation, scar revision, body contouring procedures, gynecomastia surgery, breast surgery, abdominoplasty, Botox, chemical peels, and other aesthetic treatments tailored to individual goals.

The department also provides comprehensive care for hand surgery, burn management, skin cancer surgery, scar management, benign and malignant skin lesions, soft tissue tumors, and post-burn deformity correction. Our specialists are skilled in treating both acute injuries and long-term reconstructive challenges, helping patients regain function, confidence, and quality of life.

detail.intro: The Diabetes & Family Medicine Department at Badr Al Samaa provides comprehensive healthcare services for individuals and families, with a special focus on diabetes prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and long-term disease management. Our experienced physicians are committed to delivering personalized, patient-centred care that promotes lifelong health and well-being.
body: The department specializes in the management of Type 1 Diabetes, Type 2 Diabetes, gestational diabetes, prediabetes, obesity, metabolic syndrome, hypertension, dyslipidaemia, thyroid disorders, and other lifestyle-related medical conditions. Through regular monitoring, medication management, patient education, and lifestyle counselling, we help patients achieve better disease control and reduce the risk of complications.

Our diabetes care services include comprehensive diabetic assessments, blood sugar management, insulin therapy guidance, diabetic complication screening, foot care assessment, nutritional counselling, and preventive strategies aimed at protecting long-term health. We place strong emphasis on early intervention and individualized treatment plans to support optimal diabetes outcomes.

As a Family Medicine service, we provide holistic healthcare for adolescents, adults, and elderly patients. Our physicians manage common acute illnesses, chronic diseases, preventive health concerns, routine health screenings, vaccinations, and long-term wellness programs. We focus on continuity of care, ensuring patients receive coordinated medical support throughout every stage of life.

The department also promotes preventive healthcare through regular health check-ups, cardiovascular risk assessment, weight management programs, smoking cessation support, and lifestyle modification counselling. By combining diabetes expertise with comprehensive family healthcare, we help patients and families maintain healthier lives and prevent future health complications.

detail.intro: The Oral, Maxillofacial & Dental Surgery Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital provides specialized care for conditions affecting the teeth, jaws, mouth, face, and neck. Our experienced oral and maxillofacial surgeons and dental specialists offer comprehensive diagnostic, surgical, reconstructive, and rehabilitative treatments using advanced techniques and modern technology.
body: The department specializes in the management of facial trauma, jaw fractures, impacted teeth, wisdom tooth extractions, oral infections, cysts and tumours of the oral cavity, temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disorders, and complex conditions affecting the facial bones and soft tissues. We also provide expert surgical care for congenital conditions such as cleft lip and cleft palate, helping patients achieve improved function, appearance, and quality of life.

Our services include dental implant surgery, oral rehabilitation procedures, bone grafting, corrective jaw surgeries, oral biopsies, oral surgery and treatment of oral lesions and diseases. We work closely with orthodontists and other dental specialists to provide multidisciplinary care for patients requiring comprehensive treatment planning and long-term oral health management.

The department also offers advanced facial reconstructive and corrective procedures following trauma, disease, or congenital abnormalities. Through personalized treatment plans and evidence-based surgical care, we focus on restoring oral function, facial harmony, and patient confidence.

Supported by modern surgical facilities and a highly skilled team of specialists, the Oral, Maxillofacial & Dental Surgery Department at Badr Al Samaa Hospital is committed to delivering safe, effective, and patient-centred care for both routine and complex oral and facial conditions.

detail.intro: Audiology is the testing and management of hearing and balance problems in people of all ages. Early identification of hearing loss and ear diseases is key to effective management in all age groups.
body: Badr Al Samaa Group of Hospitals has an array of audiologists who diagnose, manage, and treat hearing, balance, or ear problems.
They diagnose and treat auditory (hearing) disorders and vestibular (spatial balance) problems related to the inner ear.

detail.intro: Badr Seeds of Innocence IVF & Fertility Centre at Badr Al Samaa Premium Medical Centre, Mabella is a Centre of Excellence for Advanced IVF and Reproductive Genetics, offering comprehensive fertility care supported by state-of-the-art technology, advanced laboratory facilities, and a team of highly experienced fertility specialists. We are committed to helping individuals and couples overcome fertility challenges through personalized treatment plans and compassionate care.
body: Our centre provides a complete range of assisted reproductive treatments including Intrauterine Insemination (IUI), In Vitro Fertilization (IVF), Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI), fertility preservation, egg freezing, and embryo, sperm, and oocyte cryopreservation. Every treatment plan is carefully tailored to the patient's unique medical history, fertility goals, and reproductive needs.

In addition to advanced fertility treatments, we offer specialized reproductive genetics services designed to improve treatment outcomes and support healthy pregnancies. These include Carrier Genetic Screening, Preimplantation Genetic Testing for Aneuploidy (PGT-A), Preimplantation Genetic Testing for Monogenic Disorders (PGT-M), and male infertility genetic evaluation. Our advanced genetic testing services help identify potential genetic conditions, optimize embryo selection, and enhance the chances of successful pregnancy.

The centre also provides PRP and ovarian rejuvenation therapies, fertility-enhancing procedures, laparoscopy, hysteroscopy, and comprehensive fertility assessments for both men and women. Our multidisciplinary team closely monitors every stage of treatment, providing continuous guidance, counselling, and emotional support throughout the fertility journey.

At Badr Seeds of Innocence IVF & Fertility Centre, we combine clinical expertise, cutting-edge technology, and patient-centred care to help patients achieve their dream of parenthood with confidence, hope, and the highest standards of reproductive healthcare.

detail.intro: Department of Neurosurgery always ensures you are treated by well qualified neurosurgeon having most appropriate expertise for your condition. Working with a multidisciplinary team, you can be rest assured that our specialist surgeons will adopt a holistic approach to your treatment, taking in your individual needs in order to get you on your way to a speedy recovery.
body: Our Neurosurgery Department provides a full range of neurosurgery specialty services with full-time presence of brain and spine surgeon for timely emergency surgical interventions and ICU monitoring.

Diagnosis and management of lumbar disc disease, degenerative lumbar spinal stenosis, spondylolysis, and spondylolisthesis. Management includes conservative treatments as well as surgery, when indicated, for micro-discectomy, decompressive laminectomy, interbody fusion and spinal instrumentation.

Diagnosis and management of cervical disc disease, degenerative cervical spinal stenosis, and spondylosis. Management includes conservative treatments as well as surgery, when indicated, for anterior cervical discectomy, anterior cervical fusion, decompressive cervical laminectomy and posterior cervical fixation.

Diagnosis and management of major head and spine trauma, including a detailed analysis of brain and spine imaging, neurointensive care, intracranial pressure monitoring, craniotomy for evacuation of intracranial bleeding, decompression and fixation of spine fractures, and microscopic repair of injured peripheral nerves.

detail.intro: The department of Spine Surgery has the presence of a full-time spine surgeon for timely emergency managements and interventions. The Spine Unit offers comprehensive non-surgical and surgical treatments for the full spectrum of spinal disorders and spinal injuries and emergencies. Our experts in spine care specialize in disorders including degenerative conditions of the spine, such as cervical or lumbar spinal stenosis, cervical or lumbar disc herniation, and scoliosis or adult deformity of the spine and spinal fixation and augmentation.
body: We have specific expertise in the management of spinal cord and spinal column tumors and traumatic spinal injuries.
Degenerative spinal discopathies (microdiscectomy)
Sudden foot drop and urinary incontinence microneurosurgical management (caudaequina syndrome )
Spinal instabilities fixation( all levels instrumentation)

detail.intro: Badr-Karkinos Centre for Cancer Care is a comprehensive and multidisciplinary oncology department at Badr Al Samaa Group of Hospitals which is a part of a Distributed Cancer Care Network (DCCN). Badr Al Samaa Group of Hospitals join hands with Karkinos Healthcare from India to provide world class, evidence based and personalized cancer care in Oman with the help of digital technology. Karkinos Healthcare is a purpose driven technology-led oncology platform, focused on designing and delivering bespoke solutions for cancer care.
body: Under this collaboration, Badr-Karkinos Centre for Cancer Care, the will get access to a large number globally acclaimed oncology professionals from all disciplines of Oncology including medical, surgical, radiation oncologists, radiologist, pathologists etc. The Oncology department in Badr Al Samaa Group of Hospitals has full time experience Radiation / Clinical Oncologist will anchor the activities with the help of a Virtual Tumor Board facility.
Expert Patient Evaluation, Diagnosis and Staging
Tumor Board Facility (with more than 25 expert oncologists including medical, surgical, radiation oncologists, radiologists, pathologists etc from India)
Expert opinions through Virtual Tumor Board

packages.title: Health check-up packages
packages.intro: 41 preventive packages with prices for each country, from a basic executive check to complete heart and body screening.

items.name: Executive Body Check Up
items.text: Your wellbeing is very important for yourself and the family, which is why we have come up with the Executive Body Check-up package. This package deals with an in-depth analysis of all the systems in your body and should be repeated at least once every year to ensure any ill health is nipped in the bud before it takes root in your body. The package includes a Urine RE , Abdominal Ultrasound Scan, Serum Creatinine, an exhaustive blood study including your Hb, Total WBC, Differential Count, chest x-ray, ECG and dietary advice during an all-inclusive physician consultation.

items.name: Preliminary Cardiac & Body Check Up
items.text: After a certain age, a holistic body check-up is required on a regular basis, both for men and women. The Preliminary Cardiac and Body Check-up package ensures that any changes in the body’s health status are caught in time and treated accordingly. It includes a detailed Urine Analysis, a chest x-ray, ECG and Total Cholesterol. It also consists of Abdominal Ultra Sound Scan, Serum Creatinine, and FBS (Fasting Blood Sugar). Cardiology Consultation is also included in this package.

items.name: Asthma & Allergy Check Up
items.text: Changing lifestyles, rising pollution and increasingly artificial diets have led to a rise in asthma and allergy cases. Since allergies can result in damage to other organs and systems of the body too, it’s essential to check their possible side-effects. The Asthma & Allergy Check-up package determines the extent of involvement of the various systems and includes a physician consultation.
incl: Liver Function Test: Total, direct, and indirect Bilirubin Liver Enzymes (SGPT, SGOT, Alkaline Phosphatase)
Renal Function Test: Blood Urea, Serum Creatinine, Serum Uric acid

items.name: Comprehensive Diabetic Check Up
items.text: Lifestyle changes have led to an upsurge in diseases like diabetes. This disease can be hereditary too and can adversely affect a number of organs if left unchecked. A timely check-up ensures your wellbeing and longevity of life. The Comprehensive Diabetic Check Up includes a detailed study of the sugar levels over the past few months. Other systems are also checked to ensure they haven’t been affected by the scourge of diabetes and include an ECG and liver, kidneys and lipid profiling. An Eye Specialist Consultation and Specialist Physician Consultation is also included in this package.
incl: Renal function test: Blood Urea, Serum Creatinine, Serum Uric acid
Lipid Profile: Total Cholesterol, HDL Cholesterol, LDL Cholesterol, VLDL Cholesterol, Serum Triglyceride levels

items.name: Master Health Check Up
items.text: Your health is your biggest asset and deserves the best care possible. However, the pressures of busy lifestyles can lead to a backslide in health, which is why we have created the Master Health Check-up package – the best way to ensure you are hale and hearty. This package incorporates an extensive study of all the important systems in your body and includes a detailed blood analysis which includes Hb, Total WBC, Differential Count, an ECG, chest x-ray, abdominal ultrasound, an intensive liver, and kidney function analysis, lipid profile. It also includes a Specialist physician consultation.
incl: Specialist Physician Consultation (Including one month free consultation)
Lipid profile: Total cholesterol, HDL Cholesterol, LDL Cholesterol, VLDL Cholesterol, Serum Triglyceride Levels
Renal Function Test: Blood Urea, Serum Uric acid, Serum Creatinine

items.name: Protein Urea Check Up
items.text: Periodic preventive health check-ups ensure that disease conditions are caught in their nascent stage when they are more treatable. The Protein Urea Check-up includes extensive examination of blood and urine for a variety of diseases and also includes USG, ECG and a chest x-ray. This package determines whether your major systems are functioning properly and includes a urological consultation too.
incl: Liver Function Test: Total, direct, and indirect Bilirubin Liver Enzymes (SGPT, SGOT, Alkaline Phosphatase)
Renal Function Test: Blood Urea, Serum Creatinine, Serum Uric acid

items.name: High Blood Pressure & Heart Check Up
items.text: The amount of wear and tear faced by the body over time can leave damaging marks on your heart and its functions. Regular check-ups become necessary after middle age or if you have some underlying health conditions. High blood pressure is a dangerous disease that can damage organs, especially if it is left uncontrolled. Aside from regular check-ups with your doctor, it’s wiser to go for High blood pressure and Cardiac checkups regularly. This package includes an analysis of your diabetic status, liver function, kidney function, lipid profile, and heart health.
incl: Lipid Profile: Total Cholesterol, HDL Cholesterol, LDL Cholesterol, VLDL Cholesterol, Serum Triglyceride levels
Liver Function Test: Total, direct, and indirect Bilirubin Liver Enzymes (SGPT, SGOT, Alkaline Phosphatase)
Renal Function Test: Blood Urea, Serum Creatinine, Serum Uric acid

items.name: Comprehensive Renal Check Up
items.text: Life is never perfect, and unfavourable conditions pop up once in a while in everyone’s lives. The Comprehensive Renal Check-up package ensures that conditions associated with the kidneys and the urinary system are identified early-on when treatments are more effective and less aggressive. Aside from blood and urine analysis, x-rays, ultrasound scan, and a nephrologists’ consultation are also included.

items.name: Executive Cardiac Check Up
items.text: With increasingly sedentary lifestyles, regular cardiology check-ups are becoming more pertinent. Since the heart’s output can be influenced by other underlying disease conditions too, our Executive Cardiac Check Up package includes profiling of the lipids and liver. All this is aside from the main assessment tests associated with clinical studies of the heart. We conduct ECG and ECHO Cardiogram to check every aspect of your cardiac function. What’s more, the package also includes a cardiology consultation and Total and differential blood counts.

items.name: WELLNESS CHECK UP
items.text: This package is designed keeping in mind that people are realising the importance of identifying health issues in their primary stage and taking preventive measures before they get worse. The Wellness package is a comprehensive check-up of all the important organs in the body that get affected by unhealthy lifestyles as well as the natural ageing process. Key illnesses like hypertension, diabetes, artery diseases and thyroid disorders are given precedence in this package. It’s also inclusive of a physician consult.

items.name: MEN'S HEALTH CHECK UP
items.text: Preventive measures taken in a timely manner allow you to enjoy life without any worries. This health screening package focuses on problems that may arise in association with men’s urinary and reproductive system. Aside from the blood and urine test, there is also an ultrasound of the abdomen included. For men above 45 years of age, an additional test for prostate is also included. At the end of the tests, there will be a urologist consultation and a physical examination.

items.name: COMPREHENSIVE CHECK UP
items.text: A comprehensive check-up of the body is a routine check-up that’s suitable for everyone. It can be done every six months to one year depending on your age, gender, activity and risk factors. Since many diseases start silently and only become diagnosed after the disease has progressed significantly and affected the heart, liver, kidney or arteries, its highly recommended that everyone should go for regular comprehensive check-ups of the body. This package also includes a specialist consultation at the end.

items.name: FEMALE HORMONE PACKAGE
items.text: Designed especially for females, this package is suitable for adolescents as well as women. The hormonal assays included in this package have been implicated as the root cause of many conditions related to women’s health and normal bodily functions. They are also related to reproductive health, a topic that is garnering increasing interest with the rising cases of infertility. It also checks for anaemia as well as thyroid issues that could exacerbate underlying conditions. The package includes a gynaecologist consultation too.

items.name: EXECUTIVE CHECK UP
items.text: This package is very relevant for men and women above the age of 25 years. It is a detailed study of all the systems in the body with emphasis on the increasing prevalence of hypertension, thyroid disease and diabetes. It also includes a chest x-ray and an ultrasound scan of the abdomen to make it more all-inclusive. Since comprehensive medical care takes time, you will need to be patient with us while we assess every aspect of your wellness.

items.name: Well Women check up
items.text: Increasing awareness about disease patterns makes it essential for women of all ages to go for regular check-ups. This package becomes all the more relevant with the increasing years in a woman’s life. Nipping diseases in the bud before they take hold is always better than going through the hassles of treatment procedures. Our Well Woman package is very comprehensive in its outlook and includes a general body check-up with greater emphasis on female organs and includes a gynaecology consult.

items.name: Master Check up
items.text: This package is meant for a holistic body check-up and includes an exhaustive list of analysis of the different systems in the body. In this package, we go into a detailed assessment of diseases that are associated with unhealthy lifestyles, hereditary diseases as well as conditions arising from the natural ageing of the human body. This package is suitable for both male and female adults and at the end of it, we provide you with specialist consultations, which are all-inclusive.

Since the heart’s output can be influenced by other underlying disease conditions too, our comprehensive heart check-up package includes profiling of the liver, kidneys, lipids, thyroid and diabetic status. All this is aside from the main assessment tests associated with clinical studies of the heart. We conduct ECG, ECHO and TMT to check every aspect of your cardiac function. What’s more, the package also includes a specialist cardiology consultation.

faq.q: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a: Use the online form, call the 24/7 helpline on +968 2271 7171, or message the team on WhatsApp at +968 9393 2255. Choose your branch and a coordinator confirms the slot.

faq.q: Is emergency care available around the clock?
faq.a: Yes. Emergency care is staffed 24x7 by in-house physicians, trauma surgeons and nurses, with ambulances, portable life support, blood bank and laboratory services. Ambulance: +968 2479 9760.
The group works with the region's major insurers on a cashless basis, including NEXtCARE, MetLife, GIG, Cigna, Bupa, Allianz Worldwide Care, Oman Insurance Company and National Health Insurance.

faq.q: How much is a health check-up?
faq.a: Packages in Oman start at OMR 35 for the Executive Body Check Up and go up to OMR 115 for the Complete Heart & Body Check Up. Prices for Bahrain, Kuwait, UAE and Qatar are on the packages page.

faq.q: Can I see a doctor by video?
faq.a: Yes. Video consultations can be booked online with doctors at each branch.
The medical tourism team arranges visa processing for patients and relatives, flights and airport transfers, and accommodation with dietary needs.

faq.q: Which countries do you operate in?
faq.a: Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait and the UAE, with hospitals, medical centres and polyclinics in each.
